We need to produce correct formatted response. Let's construct:

<thought>We will search for templates that break an aryl halide (the leaving group) in the target molecule. No need to specify formed functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1c4ccc(S(=O)(=O)O)cc4",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
